_comment: APPROVED SET. Prices below are INDICATIVE ONLY, taken from third-party comparison articles during discovery; they are NOT evidence and must never appear in a report. The analysis run replaces every one with a first-party snapshot of the competitor's own pricing page.
analysis_priority: pricing — user's stated focus is where Get Leads with AI is being undercut. Depth goes into what is actually included at each price point and where cheap tiers impose hidden caps.
market_structure_note: This category is layered rather than flat: Apollo is a data/prospecting layer, Clay an enrichment/workflow layer, Instantly a sending-infrastructure layer, Lemlist a personalization/multichannel layer. Get Leads with AI spans scraping + list building + outreach, so it competes with several layers at once — which is likely why competitors appear to be multiplying.

competitors.name: Apollo.io
competitors.rationale: Closest structural match — B2B database, list building and outreach sequences in one product, aimed at SMB. The reference point buyers compare everything against.

competitors.name: Instantly
competitors.rationale: Price leader for the SMB segment, bundling a lead database with sending. Sets the floor our pricing is judged against.

competitors.name: Clay
competitors.rationale: The AI-native benchmark for scraping and list building specifically — Claygent does web research per contact. Premium-priced, which makes it the useful contrast to Instantly.

competitors.name: Lemlist
competitors.rationale: Multichannel outreach with a lead database and AI personalization — overlaps our outreach claim most directly. Raised prices in Feb 2026, worth watching.

competitors.name: Smartlead
competitors.rationale: Direct SMB cold-email competitor at a near-identical entry price to Instantly. Included to see whether the $37-39 floor is a two-player anomaly or the market rate.

competitors.name: AiSDR
competitors.rationale: Packaged AI SDR aimed at startups — same buyer and budget, different shape. Represents the 'done-for-you agent' alternative to our toolkit approach.

competitors.name: 11x
competitors.rationale: Fully autonomous 'AI digital worker' positioning, heavily funded. Indicates where the category's narrative is heading and how far buyer expectations may move.
competitors.notes: Pricing not published — contact sales. Tracked for positioning, not price.

runners_up.name: SyncGTM
runners_up.why: Closest pipeline match (scrape → enrich → verify → CRM) but small; swap in if we want a same-size comparator

runners_up.name: Persana
runners_up.why: AI SDR workflow builder for startups; overlaps AiSDR

runners_up.name: Artisan
runners_up.why: Autonomous AI SDR; overlaps 11x for the aspirational slot

runners_up.name: LeadFuze
runners_up.why: Automated list building at $147/mo; narrower than us

runners_up.name: ZoomInfo / Cognism
runners_up.why: Enterprise data incumbents — sets the data-quality bar but wrong buyer for SMB comparison
